name: static-site
description: A static site or a statically-generated site (for example built with a static-site generator, or plain HTML/CSS/JS) with no backend process of its own.

runtimes.version: <from package.json engines, if a generator is used to build the site>
runtimes.provision: <needed only at build time, not to serve the finished site>

build.what: Dependencies, if the site is generated

services.port: <the site's HTTP port, if served by a small process rather than a CDN or web server>
services.start: <a static file server, or the site is served directly by a web server / CDN with no process of its own>
services.manager: <a service manager, or none if a web server serves the files directly>
services.bind: <loopback-only, if a trusted edge fronts it>
services.health: <the home page returns 200 with the expected content>

routing.staticRoot: <the built output folder, e.g. dist or public>

config.rule: no secrets belong in a static bundle - anything shipped to the browser is public

data.state: none - the site is a build artefact; content lives in the source repo or a content system, not on the serving host

deploy.script: <deploy script: build, then publish the output folder to where it is served from>
verify: a rendered page's content or the build output's hash changed - not just an HTTP 200 from the serving host
